Upsert Case By External ID.description: Creates or updates a case via the Case API v2, keyed on an external id from another system.

Bulk Create Or Update Cases.description: Upserts a batch of cases in one call via the Case API v2.

Import Cases From Spreadsheet Rows.description: Uses CommCare's Excel case importer to create or update cases from an array of rows.

Submit Form.description: Submits an XForm on behalf of a user, e.g. to register a beneficiary captured in another system.

Create Mobile Worker.description: Creates a mobile worker account, e.g. when an HR system onboards a community health worker.

Update Lookup Table.description: Replaces or appends rows in a lookup table (fixture), e.g. a facility list.

Get Cases Modified Since.description: Fetches cases of one type changed since a date; get() pages through all results.

Get Form Submissions.description: Fetches submissions of one form received since a date, e.g. to load into a data warehouse or DHIS2.

Get Case By ID.description: Fetches one case by its CommCare case id.

Get Case By External ID.description: Looks up a case using the id it has in another system.

Get Mobile Workers.description: Lists all mobile workers in the project space.

Get Lookup Table Rows.description: Fetches the rows of a lookup table, e.g. to map facility codes.
Get Lookup Table Rows.code:
// List rows of one lookup table.
get('fixture/', { fixture_type: 'facilities' });

Get Report Data.description: Downloads the rows of a configurable (UCR) report.
Get Report Data.code:
// Download configurable report data by report id.
get(`configurablereportdata/${$.data.reportId}/`, { limit: 100 });
